text: Completed the portable semantic parity court. Shared pure materialization now covers 11 fixtures on both runtimes: five dedicated edge fixtures (opaque text decoding/BOM/CRLF, exact decimals and negative zero, newline/EOF distinctions, timestamps beyond JavaScript safe integers, stable simultaneous-message ordering) plus all six checked-in synthetic corpus fixtures. Exact SHA-256 manifests and fact counts are packaged at META-INF/eyes4s/eyelink/parity-manifests.tsv; the JVM artifact test proves byte-for-byte resource equality and unique fixture IDs. A real cross-runtime defect was caught and fixed: Double.toString rendered a 1000 Hz rate as 1000.0 on JVM and 1000 on Scala.js; canonicalization now routes the decimal through BigDecimal and yields identical digests. A temporary Scala.js-only semantic mutant changed observed manifest hashing and was killed by all 11 canonical tests, while the five direct semantic assertions still passed; the source was restored. Final gates: ioJVM/test 159/159, ioJS/test 144/144, ioJVM/packageBin green, checkBoundaries green, scalafmtAll/scalafmtSbt green, git diff --check green. Packaged JAR contains both parity-manifests.tsv (12 lines: header plus 11 fixtures) and mutation-receipts.tsv. The FS2 JVM adapter remains independently covered by EyeLinkAscStreamingJvmSuite 4/4; the shared pure streaming/parser suite passes on both platforms.
